note: Every spoken line in the game. 'text' is spoken and shown as a caption. 'cue' says what the child sees at the same time. {name} is replaced with the player's first name or nickname, {team} with our team's name and {them} with the other team's name. To record a line, save it as public/voices/rich/<id>.mp3 and add the id to public/voices/packs.json.

lines.text: Hello! Let's get you ready for match day.
lines.cue: Your player appears in our blue and yellow kit.

lines.text: First, type your name in the white box. A grown-up can help.
lines.cue: The name box glows.

lines.text: Now tap a colour for your player's skin.
lines.cue: A row of skin colour circles glows.

lines.text: And tap a hair style.
lines.cue: A row of hair styles glows.

lines.text: Now tap a hair colour.
lines.cue: A row of hair colour circles glows.

lines.text: Looking great, {name}! Tap the tick when you're ready.
lines.cue: The tick button glows.

lines.text: This is your team! Tap a player to change her name or her look. You can name both teams, and choose the other team's kit.
lines.cue: Our five players stand in a row with their names. The other team's kit choices are underneath.

lines.text: It's Saturday morning. Hooray, it's game day!
lines.cue: A sunny football pitch with a goal, and a ball flying into the net.

lines.text: The team have a big game today. Coach needs one more player, someone who knows where to stand.
lines.cue: Coach and four team-mates stand on the grass, next to an empty space with a question mark.

lines.text: That's you! First, let's make your player.
lines.cue: The empty space glows yellow.

lines.text: Meet your team-mates! Tap a player to change her name or her look. You can give your team a name too. Tap the tick when you're ready.
lines.cue: Our five players stand in a row with their names, under our team's name.

lines.text: Now, who are you playing today? Give the other team a name, then choose their shirt, their colours, their shorts and their socks. Tap the tick when you're ready.
lines.cue: A player from the other team, with rows of shirts and colours to choose from.

lines.text: Brilliant, {name}! Everyone is ready. Let's go to the pitch!
lines.cue: Your player stands with the whole team and Coach, next to a football.

lines.text: Let's get your team-mate ready.
lines.cue: Your team-mate appears in our kit.

lines.text: Type her name in the white box, then choose her look. A grown-up can help.
lines.cue: The name box glows.

lines.text: She looks great! Tap the tick when you're ready.
lines.cue: The tick button glows.

lines.text: Hi {name}! Tap the glowing level to play.
lines.cue: The next level to play glows.

lines.text: You've moved up the path, {name}! Tap the glowing level to play.
lines.cue: Your player walks up the path to the next level, which glows yellow.

lines.text: More levels are coming soon.
lines.cue: The locked circle wobbles.

lines.text: Play the glowing level first. Then the next one opens.
lines.cue: The level to play next glows yellow.

lines.text: You've finished every level so far! You can play them again any time.
lines.cue: Every level on the path is green.

lines.text: Peep!
lines.cue: A whistle sound. Not spoken.

lines.text: Thump!
lines.cue: The ball is kicked. A sound, not spoken.

lines.text: Ta-dah!
lines.cue: Two happy rising notes for a good line-up. Not spoken.

lines.text: Ta-ta-ta-daaa!
lines.cue: A short goal fanfare with confetti. Not spoken.

lines.text: Twinkle!
lines.cue: Twinkly notes as a football sticker arrives. Not spoken.

lines.text: Ding-ding!
lines.cue: A warm bell for a right bonus answer. Not spoken.

lines.text: It's match day! We're {team}, in blue and yellow.
lines.cue: Our five players stand at the side of the pitch.

lines.text: We're shooting this way, up the pitch.
lines.cue: A big arrow points at their goal.

lines.text: We have the centre kick. The ball sits on the middle spot.
lines.cue: The ball bounces onto the centre mark.

lines.text: The dotted ring is a helper. Some pitches have a ring like this and some don't. It shows how far to stay from the ball: about five metres. That's about five big grown-up steps.
lines.cue: The dotted ring around the ball glows.

lines.text: Spots! Put our five players where our team stands for our centre kick.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: Tap a player, then tap where she should stand.
lines.cue: A finger taps a player, then a spot.

lines.text: When everyone is on her spot, tap the tick.
lines.cue: The tick button glows.

lines.text: Put all five players on the pitch first.
lines.cue: The players still at the side bounce.

lines.text: The rule says: everyone starts in our own half.
lines.cue: Their half turns red. The player in it has a red ring.

lines.text: The rule says: one of us starts on the ball, on the middle spot.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: The rule says: stay about five metres away from the ball until it's kicked. That's five big grown-up steps. Keep outside the dotted ring.
lines.cue: The ring turns red. The player inside it has a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, one player stands on the ball to take the kick.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: In our team, a friend stands either side of the ball, close to the halfway line. Then there are two easy passes.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our back player stands in the middle, on the line of our penalty box or just in front of it.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our keeper in the orange top goes in our goal.
lines.cue: Our goal glows.

lines.text: In our team, our front player waits just outside the ring, in the middle, ready to chase.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, a friend stands either side, further forward than our front player, opposite their players.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: Have another go.
lines.cue: The tick button comes back.

lines.text: Look for the glowing spots. That's where our team stands.
lines.cue: Glowing circles show the empty spots.

lines.text: Let's do one together. Watch.
lines.cue: One player walks to a glowing spot.

lines.text: Now you try the rest.
lines.cue: The glowing spots stay on.

lines.text: Everyone is on her spot. Great work!
lines.cue: Our players do a little jump.

lines.text: You kept trying, and now everyone is on her spot. Great work!
lines.cue: Our players do a little jump.

lines.text: The ref blows the whistle. Where should the first pass go? Tap where the ball should go.
lines.cue: The two friends, the player behind, the far end and their goal all glow.

lines.text: A pass across to a friend. Good thinking!
lines.cue: The ball rolls to the friend.

lines.text: In our team, we pass across to a friend. A long kick gives the ball away.
lines.cue: The ball flies long and the orange team gets it.

lines.text: The rule says: you can't score straight from a centre kick. Try a pass across to a friend.
lines.cue: The ball flies at their goal and a big cross appears.

lines.text: In our team, we don't pass backwards at a centre kick. Pass across to a friend beside you.
lines.cue: The ball goes back towards our goal and a big cross appears.

lines.text: Look for the glowing friends beside you. Tap one of them.
lines.cue: Only the two friends glow.

lines.text: Let's do it together. A pass across to a friend.
lines.cue: The ball rolls to a friend.

lines.text: She takes the ball forward.
lines.cue: Our player runs up the pitch with the ball.

lines.text: Pass across to a friend.
lines.cue: The ball goes across to the other friend.

lines.text: Goal! We were ready, so we could pass and score.
lines.cue: The ball hits the net. Our players jump.

lines.text: Level one done! Well played, {name}!
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 1 on it spins in.

lines.text: We scored, so the other team restarts the game with a centre kick.
lines.cue: Our goal from level one is remembered. The other team lines up.

lines.text: Here come {them}. Their kicker is on the ball.
lines.cue: Their kicker glows.

lines.text: Spots! Where do we stand when they have the centre kick? Put our five players in our defending shape.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: They kick off.
lines.cue: Their kicker passes to a friend.

lines.text: Our front player closes down straight away.
lines.cue: Our front player runs at the ball.

lines.text: We stay together and defend as a team.
lines.cue: Our players move across together.

lines.text: Their shot goes wide, out over our goal line.
lines.cue: The ball rolls past our goal and off the pitch.

lines.text: That means it's our goal kick! We'll find out about goal kicks in the next level.
lines.cue: Our keeper picks up the ball.

lines.text: Level two done! Brilliant defending, {name}!
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 2 on it spins in.

lines.text: Bonus question! Get it right to win a sticker.
lines.cue: The medal gets smaller and three pictures appear.

lines.text: At our centre kick, where does our first pass go? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Each one shows our team and an arrow from the ball.

lines.text: A long kick at their goal?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: A pass across to a friend?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: A pass back towards our goal?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! In our team, the first pass goes across to a friend. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. In our team, the first pass goes across to a friend beside you, like this one. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level one.
lines.cue: The pass across glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: When the other team takes the centre kick, where do we stand? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Their kicker is on the ball, with the helper ring round it.

lines.text: One of us right next to the ball?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: One of us in their half?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: All of us in our own half, away from the ball?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! The rule says we all stay in our own half, about five big grown-up steps from the ball. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. The rule says we all stay in our own half, about five big grown-up steps from the ball, like this one. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level two.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: You've won a sticker for your album!
lines.cue: A new sticker pops up next to the medal.

lines.text: And you've finished the match! Here's a shiny sticker.
lines.cue: A shiny trophy sticker sits next to the medal.

lines.text: This is your sticker album. Get a bonus question right to win a sticker. Tap the arrows to turn the pages.
lines.cue: The album page shows your stickers and the numbered spaces still to fill.

lines.text: When you're ready, tap the arrow to move up the path.
lines.cue: A hand points at the arrow button and says 'Tap here!'

lines.text: Tap the house to go back to the path.
lines.cue: A hand points at the house button and says 'Tap here!'

lines.text: The rule says: at a goal kick, both teams go back into their own half until the ball is kicked.
lines.cue: Their half turns red. The player in it has a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our keeper in the orange top takes the goal kick from our goal.
lines.cue: Our goal glows.

lines.text: In our team, a friend goes out wide on each side, near the corners of our penalty box. Spread wide!
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, one friend stands in the middle of our half, ready for a pass.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our front player waits just behind the halfway line, in the middle, ready to go.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our front player waits just behind the halfway line, in the middle, ready to go.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, a friend waits on each side, in our half, ready to help.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: Their shot went wide, so it's our goal kick. Our keeper will take it.
lines.cue: Our keeper has the ball in front of our goal.

lines.text: The rule says: at a goal kick, both teams go back into their own half until the ball is kicked. So {them} walk back.
lines.cue: Their players walk back over the halfway line, which glows.

lines.text: Spots! Spread wide, find a friend. Put our five players where they go for our goal kick.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: Where should our keeper pass it? Tap a place.
lines.cue: Glowing circles on our friends out wide, and an arrow up the pitch for a long kick.

lines.text: A short pass to a friend out wide. Lovely!
lines.cue: The ball rolls out to a friend on the side.

lines.text: A long kick often goes straight to them. In our team, we pass to a friend out wide.
lines.cue: The ball flies up the pitch and their keeper catches it. A red cross shows it didn't work.

lines.text: Look. Our friends out wide are glowing. Tap one.
lines.cue: Only our friends out wide glow.

lines.text: Let's do it together. A short pass out wide.
lines.cue: The ball rolls out to a friend on the side.

lines.text: Our friend takes it up the side of the pitch.
lines.cue: Our friend dribbles up the side. Everyone moves up with her.

lines.text: She passes inside. Pass and move!
lines.cue: The ball goes inside to a friend, who passes it forward.

lines.text: Our front player shoots...
lines.cue: Our front player kicks the ball at their goal.

lines.text: Just wide! So close.
lines.cue: The ball rolls past their post and off the pitch.

lines.text: It went out over their goal line, so now it's their goal kick. That's the next level.
lines.cue: Their keeper picks up the ball.

lines.text: Level three done! Next time we have a goal kick in a real match, remember: spread wide, find a friend.
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 3 on it spins in.

lines.text: Now it's their goal kick. Their keeper has the ball.
lines.cue: Their keeper has the ball in front of their goal.

lines.text: The rule says: at a goal kick, both teams go back into their own half until the ball is kicked.
lines.cue: The halfway line glows.

lines.text: Coach always says: back, wait, GO!
lines.cue: Our players do a little jump.

lines.text: Spots! Back! Put our five players where they wait for their goal kick.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: Wait...
lines.cue: Our players stand still behind the halfway line. Their keeper passes it out wide.

lines.text: GO! The ball has been kicked, so now we can chase it.
lines.cue: Our front player and a friend run at the ball.

lines.text: Our friend wins the ball. Great teamwork!
lines.cue: Our friend takes the ball off their player.

lines.text: Their player knocks it off the side of the pitch. That's a kick-in for us. We'll learn about kick-ins soon.
lines.cue: The ball rolls off the side line.

lines.text: Level four done! When they have a goal kick on Saturday, remember: back, wait, GO!
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 4 on it spins in.

lines.text: At our goal kick, where do our players go? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Our keeper has the ball in each one.

lines.text: All close to our keeper?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: All far up in their half?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: Spread out wide, with friends to pass to?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! In our team, we spread wide and find a friend. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. In our team, we spread out wide so our keeper has friends to pass to, like this one. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level three.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: When they have a goal kick, where do we wait? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Their keeper has the ball in each one.

lines.text: All of us in our own half?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: One of us right next to their keeper?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: Some of us in their half?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! The rule says we all go back into our own half until their goal kick is taken. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. The rule says we all go back into our own half until their goal kick is taken, like this one. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level four.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: The rule says: at a goal kick, both teams start in their own half. That means us too.
lines.cue: Their half turns red. The player in it has a red ring.

lines.text: The rule says: one of us takes the kick-in, with the ball still on the side line where it went out.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: The rule says: stay about five metres away from the ball until it's kicked in. That's five big grown-up steps. Keep outside the dotted ring.
lines.cue: The ring turns red. The player inside it has a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, one player stands on the ball, on the side line, to take the kick-in.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: In our team, a friend comes close to the kicker, for an easy short pass.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, a friend stands inside, towards the middle of the pitch, for another pass.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, a friend stands between their player down the line and our goal.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our front player stands between their player up the line and our goal.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, a friend stands inside, between their middle player and our goal.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: The ball went off the side, so it's our kick-in.
lines.cue: The ball rolls back to the side line.

lines.text: The rule says: put the ball still on the side line where it went out. Then pass it in or dribble it in. No throwing!
lines.cue: The ball does a little hop on the side line.

lines.text: {them} have to stand five big steps away from the ball.
lines.cue: A dotted ring glows round the ball.

lines.text: Spots! Put our five players where they go for our kick-in.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: Where should our kick-in go? Tap a place.
lines.cue: Glowing circles on our friends, and one on their player.

lines.text: A pass to a friend. Lovely!
lines.cue: The ball rolls to a friend.

lines.text: Oh! That went straight to them. Look for a friend first.
lines.cue: The ball goes to their player. A red cross shows it didn't work.

lines.text: Look. Our friends are glowing. Tap one.
lines.cue: Only our friends glow.

lines.text: Let's do it together. A short pass to a friend.
lines.cue: The ball rolls to the friend nearby.

lines.text: Pass and move! Our friend takes it towards their goal.
lines.cue: Our friends pass the ball up the pitch.

lines.text: Shot!
lines.cue: Our friend shoots.

lines.text: Their keeper saves it!
lines.cue: Their keeper catches the ball.

lines.text: Their keeper kicks it long, and they race down the other side.
lines.cue: Their player runs with the ball towards our goal.

lines.text: Our back player gets across and makes a great tackle!
lines.cue: Our back player knocks the ball off the side line.

lines.text: It went off the side off us, so now it's their kick-in. That's the next level.
lines.cue: The ball sits on the side line in our half.

lines.text: Level five done! On Saturday, when the ball goes off the side, look for a friend first.
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 5 on it spins in.

lines.text: Now it's their kick-in, in our half.
lines.cue: Their kicker glows on the side line.

lines.text: The rule says: we stay five big steps away from the ball until it's kicked in. The dotted ring helps us see.
lines.cue: The dotted ring round the ball glows.

lines.text: Spots! Where do we stand when they have a kick-in? Stand between their players and our goal.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: They pass it in.
lines.cue: Their kicker passes to a friend inside.

lines.text: Our friend was standing in the right place, so she steps in and wins it!
lines.cue: Our friend takes the ball.

lines.text: We clear it up the pitch, but they win it back.
lines.cue: The ball goes up the pitch and their player gets it.

lines.text: They pass it forward into our half. Their player runs on to it and shoots...
lines.cue: Their player runs with the ball to the edge of our penalty box and shoots.

lines.text: What a shot! Right into the top corner. Nobody could have stopped that one.
lines.cue: The ball goes into our goal. The score is one each.

lines.text: Heads up, team! We're still a team. Back to our spots.
lines.cue: Our players jump and clap each other.

lines.text: That's the whistle for half-time. One each!
lines.cue: The players walk off for a drink.

lines.text: Level six done! You defended really well. On Saturday, if a goal goes in against us, heads up and back to our spots.
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 6 on it spins in.

lines.text: At our kick-in, where do our friends stand? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Our kicker has the ball on the side line in each one.

lines.text: All right next to the kicker?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: Spread out, with friends to pass to?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: All far away up the pitch?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! In our team, a friend comes close and a friend goes inside, so there are easy passes. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. In our team, a friend comes close and a friend goes inside, like this one, so there are easy passes. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level five.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: When they have a kick-in, how close can we stand to the ball? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Their kicker is on the side line, with the helper ring round the ball.

lines.text: Right next to the ball?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: Two of us inside the ring?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: Everyone outside the ring?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! The rule says we stay five big steps away until it's kicked in. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. The rule says we stay five big steps from the ball until it's kicked in, like this one. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level six.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.
